notes.title: 🌠 Preview: New Frutiger Aero Map + Flight and Inventory
notes.notes:
✨ A new horizon is coming!

We’re preparing a major update for Explore Dreams: Dreamcore, and we want to share a preview with you.

🌐 New Map – Frutiger Aero
Inspired by the Frutiger Aero aesthetic, this map features a vibrant look, with metallic tones, intense shine, and a nostalgic future feel.

This aesthetic was popular in the 2000s and 2010s, present in systems like Windows XP and in technology advertisements — with blue skies, soft clouds, crystal clear water, bubbles, and reflections. It’s as if the digital optimism of that era has come to life in an interactive dream.

🚀 Temporary Flight
For the first time, you’ll be able to fly for a limited time! This new mechanic opens up unique possibilities for vertical exploration and discovery, giving new perspectives to dreamscapes.

🎒 Inventory
We’re developing an inventory system that allows players to collect and interact with items—an important step toward new mechanics in future phases of the game.

🌀 Stay tuned—this update will bring new layers of exploration, challenge, and immersion to the surreal universe of Explore Dreams: Dreamcore.

notes.title: Coming in 2025: Explore Dreams Customization Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Coming in 2025[/h1]

[h2]Full Customization Update for Explore Dreams: Dreamcore Multiplayer![/h2]

[h3]Get ready to transform your character in unique and creative ways with our new, advanced customization tool! With this incredible update, you’ll be able to:

🎨 Choose unique skin tones and details to create the perfect look for your avatar.
👒 Add accessories like hats, glasses, and other stylish items that match your personality.
👀 Select stunning, expressive eyes with customizable design and color options.
👗 Create amazing outfit combinations to add even more style to your character.

This update is another step towards ensuring that every player can tell their own story with a truly unique character. Stay tuned for more news leading up to the 2025 launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329346/c3ad6a301c400ac898ff405f9e3b765f492cd9eb.png[/img]

Customize Every Detail:

You'll have complete control over your character's style and personality with new and fun options:

🎒 Choose from different backpacks – from a fun fish model to more functional backpacks, like an oxygen tank, each item has color options to match your style.
👕 Put together your look with amazing clothes and accessories – from colorful coats to modern and comfortable styles. 🧦 Customize shoes and other items to create unique and striking combinations.[/h3]
